steps.code: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user commutescout https://mcp.commutescout.com/mcp

steps.text: With a key, for saved places:

steps.code:
claude mcp add --transport http --scope user commutescout https://mcp.commutescout.com/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer cs_live_..."

steps.text: Run /mcp inside Claude Code to confirm it connected.
Customize > Connectors > + Add > Add custom connector. Name: CommuteScout. URL: https://mcp.commutescout.com/mcp. Sign-in: No sign in.
For saved places, add a request header named Authorization with the value Bearer cs_live_...
On Team and Enterprise plans, an owner adds it first under Organization settings > Connectors. The connector also appears in Claude Desktop and the mobile apps.
Add to ~/.cursor/mcp.json, or .cursor/mcp.json in a project:
Leave out headers to connect without a key.
Leave out headers and inputs to connect without a key.
Add to its mcp_config.json (MCP settings > view raw config):

steps.code: gemini mcp add --transport http commutescout https://mcp.commutescout.com/mcp

steps.text: Add --header "Authorization: Bearer cs_live_..." for saved places.
On chatgpt.com: Plugins > + > Add custom MCP server. URL: https://mcp.commutescout.com/mcp. Authentication: none.
Custom MCP servers depend on your plan and workspace settings. ChatGPT offers sign-in (OAuth) rather than a key field, so use addresses instead of "home" and "work" there.
Streamable HTTP at https://mcp.commutescout.com/mcp: stateless, no sign-in, optional Authorization: Bearer cs_live_... (or X-API-Key).
